protocol.scaling: Fit only on training fold; inner diagnostic scalers fit only inner training fold.
protocol.selection: No hyperparameter selection or early stopping (Logistic).

input.source: database/windows/*/*.npz f/e, bijectively aligned to highdim_deep_features.npz by subject, label and float32 waveform SHA256; raw/X never model inputs

protocol.stress_usage: Flip evaluation labels only; never used for training, tuning, orientation or selection.
protocol.polarity_control: DIAGNOSTIC, not deployment claim: train-subject signs estimated from 4-fold subject-disjoint inner OOF AUC; refit with aligned TRAIN labels. One global output direction fixed from original training-label AUC; never uses test labels/statistics for inference. Training sign estimation still uses labels and may overfit.
protocol.oracle_usage: Evaluation only, per-subject max(AUC,1-AUC); never alters model predictions.

oracle_only.warning: Uses held-out labels separately for each subject; diagnostic upper bound, NOT deployable.
